title: State Registry Compliance Note: Match Window for Registry Copies on Immunization Services Courses
content:
An Immunization Services course can carry plan-billed dose entries recorded from another provider. This note fixes when such an entry, on a course to which a dose is being posted, is matched as a registry copy of Kestrel's report to the state immunization registry.

**Clause.** A plan-billed entry recorded from another provider is matched as a registry copy when it is dated no more than a match window of days after the latest dose Kestrel gave on the course at the course's store: 3 days where Kestrel reported a dose of the course to the state registry, 1 day where it reported none and a documented cash-paid entry from another provider is on the course, and 0 days, that is the same day only, otherwise.

## Terms

- **Plan-billed entry recorded from another provider** — a dose entry that names no Kestrel store and is billed to a pharmacy benefit.
- **Latest dose Kestrel gave on the course at the course's store** — the most recent dose entry naming the store the course is held at. An entry is matched only against that dose.
- **Documented cash-paid entry from another provider** — a cash-paid dose entry naming no Kestrel store and carrying a lot number.
- **Dated no more than the window after** — the entry is dated on the day of that Kestrel dose or later, and the calendar days from the Kestrel dose's date to the entry's date do not exceed the window.

## Window by the state of the course

| State of the course | Match window |
|---|---|
| Kestrel reported a dose of the course to the state registry | 3 days |
| No Kestrel registry report on the course, and a documented cash-paid entry from another provider is on it | 1 day |
| Neither of the above | 0 days — the same day only |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

| Hypothetical situation | Calendar days from the Kestrel dose to the plan-billed entry | Window | Matched as a registry copy |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel reported a dose | 3 | 3 | Yes |
| Kestrel reported a dose | 4 | 3 | No |
| No report, documented cash-paid outside entry present | 1 | 1 | Yes |
| No report, documented cash-paid outside entry present | 2 | 1 | No |
| No report, no documented cash-paid outside entry | 0 (same day) | 0 | Yes |
| No report, no documented cash-paid outside entry | 1 | 0 | No |
| Any | Entry dated before the Kestrel dose | Any | No |

A plan-billed entry recorded from another provider that falls outside its window is not a matched registry copy.
